host_adapter.location: host-tools beside the verified package, when the producer interpreter is absent
host_adapter.scope: Generated launcher wrappers and explicit sysroot selection. The archive, ELF files and libraries stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Compiler/application tests qualify the selected host route separately.

compatibility.scope: Produced BlueFe rustc through the Lustr compatibility coordinator. Linux x86_64 execution and Wasm linking are qualified by the producer; application acceptance is recorded separately. Native Lust is absent.

native_lust.route: Historical separately qualified native Lust subset, retained without changing compiler identity. The compatibility archive does not supply this compiler.
native_lust.qualification: Existing receipts qualify only their exact application and compiler inputs; rerun adapter gates after changes.
